## Names

<a id="cmd_lines"></a>
### [`cmd_lines`](../../../../src/tools/lines.asm#L6) `$0DE0`

*routine*

Command 3 (Lines): connected lines. The first point comes from $1168. Then for each next point ($104b): it removes the band line, draws the line in current_colour ($2746), and the end point becomes the start point. The band lines use picture_background ($5bff) and the plot routine of $2751 (a second draw at the same place removes the line).

- **Entry of:** [`command_table`](../../tables.md#command_table)
- **Calls:** [`start_tool`](tool_start.md#start_tool), [`wait_first_point`](line_tool.md#wait_first_point), [`line_rubber_band`](line_tool.md#line_rubber_band), [`draw_line_xor`](../graphics/bresenham_line.md#draw_line_xor), [`draw_line_brush`](../graphics/bresenham_line.md#draw_line_brush)
- **Reads:** [`current_colour`](../../memory-map.md#current_colour), [`background_colour`](../data/title_picture_5bff.md#background_colour), [`saved_colour`](../../memory-map.md#saved_colour), [`shape_x1`](../../memory-map.md#shape_x1), [`shape_y1`](../../memory-map.md#shape_y1)
- **Writes:** [`saved_colour`](../../memory-map.md#saved_colour), [`current_colour`](../../memory-map.md#current_colour), [`shape_x0`](../../memory-map.md#shape_x0), [`shape_y0`](../../memory-map.md#shape_y0)
